exact_missing_items: archived: historical object retained in the model, but not an active live lane
removed: live backing removed; only historical identity and lineage remain
historical: user-facing historical posture rather than dispatchable live posture
recover: attempt to restore or reconcile a suspect/orphaned/conflicted worktree into a safe known state
archive: retire from active use while preserving enough identity/metadata/lineage for historical browsing
prune: cleanup-oriented for policy-eligible stale/orphaned/live-no-longer-needed worktrees; narrower than generic remove
remove: explicit destructive removal of live worktree backing after confirmation and eligibility checks
live cleanup must never erase run/lane/worktree lineage from History, Ledger, or graph-linked inspection
Orchestrator owns lane-pool truth and cleanup posture in execution context
Source Control owns concrete worktree actions and compact inventory display
gap_candidates.blocking_reason: Coverage row indicates incomplete or missing canon alignment for concrete target.
